theme_and_context.design_persona: Premium, clean, modern, and highly functional. Blends Swiss High-Contrast clarity with Soft Neutral warmth to create a trustworthy and efficient car rental management tool for the Indonesian market.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]) instead of harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders with 40-60% opacity for a crisp, cardless/light-card aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-xl for main cards/widgets, rounded-lg for buttons and inputs.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous padding. Use p-6 or p-8 inside containers with borders to avoid text collision and provide breathing room.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Summary metrics take col-span-1. Charts take col-span-2. Recent lists take col-span-2 or 4.
layouts_and_grids.navigation: Mobile-first responsive. On desktop: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with white background and right border. On mobile: Sticky top header with hamburger menu opening a Shadcn Sheet/Drawer.
layouts_and_grids.page_container: Flex column, taking remaining width. Add px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 for main content area.

component_patterns.auth: Clean centered card layout for JWT Email+Password login. Title: 'Masuk ke ARMI Rental'.
component_patterns.whatsapp_buttons: Use clear green CTA buttons with WhatsApp icon for deep links (wa.me/...). Style: bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.
component_patterns.data_tables: Shadcn Table. Clean rows with hover:bg-slate-50. Status pills in a dedicated column.
component_patterns.forms: Shadcn Forms, Inputs, Selects. Auto-calculate total price on the frontend before submitting rental creation. Prevent double booking logic clearly displayed.
component_patterns.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for date range picking in reports and rental dates.
component_patterns.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard clarity (install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) or fallback to lucide-react.

motion.interactions: Subtle translate-y on hover for clickable cards (-translate-y-1). Transition colors on hover (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders (Shadcn Skeleton) for dashboard widgets and tables while fetching data.
motion.toasts: Use Sonner for success/error notifications (e.g., 'Kendaraan berhasil ditambahkan', 'Booking bentrok!').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially small labels, meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='vehicle-status-filter', data-testid='revenue-total').

media.instructions: Use these placeholder images for Vehicle CRUD photo upload previews, dashboard recent rentals, and customer profile avatars. Never use raw placeholder.com text.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
Do NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural left-aligned reading flow.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper SVG icons.
Ensure the UI uses 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) than usual to avoid the cramped 'AI slop' look.
For interactions, always define explicit hover, active, and focus states.
Create depth using z-index hierarchy, subtle borders, and soft shadows rather than flat 2D color blocking.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Ensure they have a solid or highly opaque blurred background.
Ensure ALL UI components (.js files) follow the React functional component structure.
